shared_type_carveout.rule: Imports whose target_domain is in this list are ALWAYS OK, for every chunk. Do not flag them.

boundary_rules.reason: Config files (go.mod, wails.json, Makefile, .github) are metadata; they do not import any application code.
Persistence layer must remain a leaf package; it constructs queries and wraps transactions but must never reference business logic, UI, or external data.
Ledger and rankings are the financial core; they read from and write to the store but must not reach into the binding layer or external data.
The Wails bridge exposes Go methods to JS; it may call business logic but must not import React components or external data consumers.
External data ingestion (MFL API, file loads) must not mutate business-logic engines; it may persist normalized data to the store only.
Pure business rules; direct db/store imports should go through interfaces — real edges exist (1x db, 2x store), flag for adjudication.
React components only call bound methods on the Wails surface; they must not import Go packages, the store, or business logic.
Tests and tools are exempt per the rules; they may import any chunk for verification and cleanup purposes.
